CSDI-informed cucurbit sowing-window climatic analogue dashboard

Prototype India-scale dashboard using field-experiment CSDI anchors and NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 climate windows. The headline result is the ensemble median; individual models are diagnostic sensitivity views.

Suitability slider: historical vs future

The slider compares the historical baseline with the selected future scenario and period for the selected species, season and tested sowing-window class. The colour scale is fixed from 0 to 100.

Interpretation warning. This dashboard is not a farmer advisory product and does not provide exact sowing-date recommendations. It maps climatic analogues to experimentally tested sowing-window classes only.
Method note. This prototype maps CSDI-informed thermal climatic analogues for four cucurbit species using field-experiment CSDI anchors and NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 climate windows. It does not predict yield, observed CSDI, physiological traits, biochemical traits, or exact sowing dates. The best-window map identifies the projected best analogue among the experimentally tested SD1, SD2 and SD3 sowing-window classes only. A no-robust-recommendation class is used where the top two window scores are close or the selected window has low thermal calibration confidence.
